fullContent:
Maha Kalyanaka Ghrita 
 Reference – Ashtanga Hrudayam Uttarasthana 
 Introduction 
 Maha kalyanaka ghrita is an ayurvedic formulation. This is a polyherbal formulation in which ghee is used as a base. This is very good to treat problems related with psyche and brain. It is very useful during pregnancy also. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Ghee – 768 g 
 Milk from cow (cow that calved for the first time) – 3.072 liters 
 Phalini – Callicarpa macrophylla 
 Vishala – Citrulus cholocynthis 
 Sariva – Hemidesmus indicus 
 Haridra – Turmeric 
 Daruharidra – Berberis aristata 
 Shalaparni – Desmodium gangeticum 
 Prishnaparni – Uraria picta 
 Bhadra ela – Amomum subulatum 
 Vella – Embelia ribes 
 Devadaru – Cedrus deodara 
 Padmaka – Prunus poddum 
 Hima – Santalum album 
 Malati – Jasminum sambac 
 Elavaluka – Prunus avium 
 Nata – Valeriana wallichi 
 Brihati – Solanum indicum 
 Kushta – Saussurea lappa 
 Manjishta – Rubia cordifolia 
 Ela – Cardamom 
 Nagakeshara – Mesua ferrea 
 Dadimaphalatwak – Punica granatum 
 Talisapatra – Abbies webbiana 
 Utpala – Nymphea stellata 
 Danti – Baliospermum montanum 
 Triphala – Known to contain following herbs up to 12 grams – Haritaki (Terminalia chebula), Bibhitaki (Terminalia bellirica), Amla (mblica officinalis) 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 Take the above ingredients and combine in a container. 
 Heat these till herbal ghee is prepared. 
 
 Dose 
 Quarter to half teaspoon, one to two times a day, before bed time, with water. 
 Indications 
 
 Weakness or lack of memory 
 Schizophrenia 
 Psychosis 
 Epilepsy 
 Fever 
 Infertility 
 Cough 
 Anemia 
 
 Contraindications 
 
 Take precautions if suffer from the problem of high BP, high cholesterol and heart problems. 
 Diarrhea and indigestion can be caused due to over dose. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
